on_each_trigger.rule: Read exact current main, bootstrap, supervisor and newest Trigger-2 ledger before making current claims or writes. Moving-main reentry is mandatory after parallel writes.

Hash new Claude Code/user handoffs and record provenance, target architecture, measured/inferred/unmeasured status, predecessor/successor and revision reason. Never silently merge conflicting measurements.

Re-audit current and historical generators/seeds/rows against the newest ontology and evidence. Classify CURRENT, CANDIDATE, RETROFIT_REQUIRED, COMPONENT_ONLY, QUARANTINE, SUPERSEDED, STALE, BLOCKED or RECHECK_REQUIRED. High-coverage retrofit takes priority over flat new volume.

Every integrated trainable episode operates in a branch carrier equivalent to h_i=(v_i,K_i,E_i+,E_i-,F_i,T_i,A_i,sigma_i), with branch-local evidence/counterevidence, provenance/dependence, epistemic type, before/after state, non-destructive projection and explicit resolution state. Full D optimization remains curriculum-late.

For D/E, the deterministic chain must begin at a formal synthetic task world or source-bound proof: formal world -> predicted outcomes/observations -> SUPPORTS/COUNTERS/FALSIFIES/irrelevant + dependence identity -> U update -> discriminator adequacy/order -> D resolution. Caller-supplied branch relations, decision roles, target branches or utility counts are not sufficient label authority.

Exact replay and repackaging do not multiply evidence. Dependence/correlation ancestry and payload/event identity must be preserved; same causal evidence through another worker/file/ancestry remains non-independent.

Use C1 as the cheap preflight, then C2-C6, A, B, E and D, followed by an integrated A+B+C+D+E mixture with rehearsal. Hyperposition carrier is present throughout, but fixed labels isolate C before dynamic codebook B is combined. A+B-only vector-language corpora remain COMPONENT_ONLY unless embedded in the integrated operating frame.

D P1 is weak/suggestive only; D P2 open-vs-resolved is quarantined as confounded until rebuilt with lexically indistinguishable matched variants and a lexical-only control. Do not train or claim progress from the invalid P2.

Every claimed effect requires a matched control. Model-visible nuisances must be fully crossed or pass preregistered conditional-independence gates; use nuisance-only decoders/conditional MI, lexical/template/generator-family holdouts, branch permutation/renaming tests and anti-collapse hard negatives.

Bind every selected checkpoint to exact model hash + ABI manifest hash and re-measure semantic rank/decodability, centering/whitening, atom response/crosstalk, codec cycle error, write margin/damage and context transfer. Track symbol-basis drift separately from state-codec/representation drift. Test float64 external codec to bfloat16 model-boundary behavior explicitly.

Induction-head/function-vector/other circuit explanations are hypotheses. B is accepted by unseen-codebook generalization, representation/behavior double dissociation and causal lesion/rescue diagnostics, not by assuming a specific internal circuit.

Generator, adversarial shortcut hunter, epistemic reviewer, Hyperposition reviewer, provenance/Goodman reviewer, nuisance reviewer, target-architecture reviewer and final integrator independently critique candidates. Record revisions and supersession instead of overwriting history.

Source/test presence, local synthetic validation, token volume, worker consensus or model confidence cannot mint accepted dataset tokens, training credit, J-Space/HCU runtime credit or whole-product pass. Promotion requires exact-current executable gates and the evidence-qualified Forge/Distillery/TrainingTrace path.
